name: Drawbar Organ
maker: Roberto, for FreePats, recorded from the setBfree synthesizer
licence_quote: Published under the terms of the Creative Commons CC0 1.0 public domain dedication.
source: FreePats Drawbar organ emulation, version 2019-07-12 (SFZ + WAV)
notes: the WAV samples are stored as FLAC, unchanged in sound

amp_veltrack=0: a drawbar organ is not velocity sensitive, so every velocity plays at the level of the hardest (the source's default 100 swung a note 19 dB from velocity 40 to 120); a channel's velocity weight in the DAW still adds a swing

volume=-10.40: at every velocity the organ's C3 plays as loud as the median of the other pitched sets at velocity 100 (-18.6 LUFS, measured with compare.py); at full level it was the loudest set by 9 dB

loop_end is the source's less one in all 16 loops: the source writes the frame after the loop, and its files hold the loop's first frames again from there (measured), where SFZ and the DAW name the loop's last frame; read as written, every wrap played the loop's first frame twice
